research_question: Does the exact Henry Hub M1-M6 listed-contract curve exhibit material seasonal structure between winter-withdrawal and injection months?
search_scope: Fresh Programme 002 literature inventory; Mirantes et al. is direct Henry Hub evidence and Hevia-Petrella is contextual methodology only; no legacy internal outcomes or magnitudes used.

sources.title: The stochastic seasonal behavior of energy commodity convenience yields
Risk Premia and Seasonality in Commodity Futures
sources.locator: Bank of England Staff Working Paper No. 591

claim_map.claim: Henry Hub natural gas exhibits material seasonal structure in futures-price relationships and convenience yield.
Seasonality can be studied through curve-state comparisons, but Hevia-Petrella is contextual because its empirical application is heating oil.

expected_observations: The predeclared winter-withdrawal and injection distributions of monthly M1-M6 log-curve slope differ by at least the scientific MEPI with uncertainty excluding the disconfirming region.
disconfirming_observations: The seasonal slope contrast is below the scientific MEPI under informative power.
The seasonal pattern disappears when exact listed-contract maturity alignment and the fixed monthly snapshot rule are enforced.
Any apparent seasonal difference depends on changing the M1-M6 statistic, month-selection rule, or season definition after outcome access.
